rows.suggestion: Adopt a closing-price provider and archive every close into the snapshot store
rows.rationale: CLV is the least noisy verdict on a signal; without closes the store is half-empty forever.
rows.unlocks: fair-vs-market diff, CLV, ROI, demotion trigger D-1a, gate G-4
rows.decision_needed: Which provider, and budget (none identified in-repo)

rows.suggestion: Schedule the cycle-close capture (cron before Sunday kickoff) in the capture workflow
rows.rationale: The close phase exists; automating it makes the snapshot store complete for every cycle without manual input.
rows.unlocks: closing model lines per market; clean open→close lineage
rows.decision_needed: Approve the schedule (and confirm it runs before first kickoff)

rows.suggestion: Add a post-cycle CI job that evaluates D-1 triggers and flips strategy states automatically
rows.rationale: The demotion gate is only credible if it fires mechanically, not by someone's judgement.
rows.decision_needed: Approve running the gate job against staking history once prices exist

rows.suggestion: Backfill multiple prior seasons of official results
rows.rationale: G-2 needs >= 3 seasons; walk-forward CIs shrink with n; luck separation needs a real sample.
rows.unlocks: gate G-2/G-3 unblocking, sharper correlations, real CLV baselines
rows.decision_needed: Approve the storage cost (a few thousand rows) and the capture time

rows.suggestion: Keep the prop layer BLOCKED until an official prop source exists
rows.rationale: No official source publishes prop results or prop prices; estimating them would be exactly the hallucination the brief forbids.
rows.unlocks: nothing by itself; prevents a fabricated leaderboard row

rows.suggestion: Publish originated moneylines as FAIR (no-vig) lines only
rows.rationale: We originate fair lines; presenting them as bookmaker prices would confuse fair-vs-market comparisons.
rows.unlocks: clean semantics for the diff column

rows.suggestion: Rank strategies by walk-forward signal score with a minimum-n floor before any reward is paid
rows.rationale: The brief wants rewards for top performers; paying on tiny samples rewards luck — exactly what the leaderboard separation exists to prevent.
rows.unlocks: a defensible reward rule once Q-A06 is decided
rows.decision_needed: Approve the floor (proposal: n >= 300 settled signals, per G-2)

rows.suggestion: Link this module from the root landing page
rows.rationale: Root `index.html` and `hub/` are owned by the hub session (CI-guarded); this module is reachable today only by URL.
rows.decision_needed: Integration owner adds one link (logged as a request in COORDINATION.md, not self-applied)
